notes.title: Bloomtown on Mobile now has a launch date! 📱
notes.content:
Greetings, Bloomtowners! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/592f15d456bc2cb2ed1a6548e1652976a6f3f209.png

We can now reveal the release date for Bloomtown on mobile. If you've ever wanted to adventure through this quaint little town and uncover the dark world that exists in the underside, then grab your phone and get prepared for Bloomtown, coming to your mobile devices on July 30.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png
Experience Bloomtown in a new way {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/7bed581a87eec7ee8b2bf498115f10acaa8e9d47.png
If you're wondering what to expect with Bloomtown on mobile, let me assure you, you're going to get everything you have right now, just in a package adapted to mobile devices. Read on to see everything that is included in the mobile version of Bloomtown:
 Bloomtown will be available in mobile stores for free. Once downloaded, you can play the demo, which includes everything up to your first exploration through the underside. 
 Once you complete the demo, you can purchase the full game for $9.99. This includes everything available in the game's current PC/console version. The mobile version of Bloomtown is built on the most recent version of the game, including all patches and content implemented since release.
 Bloomtown has been adapted for mobile devices, ensuring a clean and easy to use UI, which optimises the play experience.

notes.title: Bloomtown is coming to mobile! 📱
notes.content:
Hey there, Bloomtowners! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8b805179ad60a63d4a27fffd3dd5750ac7daf061.png

We've got some exciting news—Bloomtown: A Different Story is officially coming to mobile devices! Soon you'll be able to experience this cozy narrative adventure on your phone or tablet via Google Play or the App Store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png

A Whole New Way to Experience Bloomtown 🧸
The mobile release isn't just a simple port—we've carefully tailored Bloomtown to ensure the experience remains seamless, intuitive, and charming on smaller screens. Now you can delve into deep storytelling, memorable characters, and the vibrant, picturesque world you've grown to love, right in the palm of your hand.

We'll announce the exact release date in the coming weeks, so be sure to follow us here and on social media to stay updated.

notes.title: Enhanced Rewards Update
notes.content:
We've just released a new major update for Bloomtown! We've just released an update for Bloomtown, chocked full of new items, enhanced quest rewards, improved localisations and much more! Check out the full details of the patch on the discussion forums or at the bottom of this blog. Thanks to everyone's feedback, which helped us find bugs, improve the game, and implement better rewards and items in the game. We appreciate every piece of feedback that you provide, so don't hesitate to take the time to leave a review of Bloomtown on Steam!

If you want to report a bug, issue, typo, or share feedback, there are two ways to do it:
Through our official Discord server
Via our customer support website
If you need info on what to include - you can find a dedicated Steam forum post here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/fa534ccf66525c66bbd1c838631c55a62f403c2f.png

What can you expect in this patch?
We've implemented new enhanced versions of items, enhanced side quest rewards, improved the balance of combat, and lots more. Let's go over some of the most important of these changes in more detail:

New Items: You'll find 20 enhanced versions of previously seen character equipment, including weapons, armor, and accessories. These will help improve your character's combat abilities more gradually as you progress through the game.
Improved quest rewards: When completing side quests, you will notice that the rewards have been improved, offering far greater bonuses. This change increases the benefits of completing side quests, making the compensation more tempting.
Improved combat balancing: We've slightly increased spell damage for both allies and enemies. This change improved combat speed, as some enemies were too spongy.
Dungeon Crates: We've reduced the number of consumables in crates, but the size of cash rewards and crafting resources has been increased to compensate. This shifts the importance from working with the specific items you are provided in dungeons; now, you have the freedom to craft the tools you require or want with the resources provided.
Improved Localisation: Based on the feedback we have received since release, we have made a large number of updates to the various localisations of Bloomtown. You should now find improved texts and more accurate translations in all game versions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png

Full patch notes
 Changed the player reward system. Significantly increased rewards for side quests. 
 Added over 20 enhanced versions of characters equipment. 
 Demons will now transfer more experience during Fusion. 
 Changed the balance of combat. 
 Reduced the number of consumables in dungeon crates but increased the number of cash rewards and resources for crafting. 
 Bugs were fixed in the training room. 
 Improved localization for all languages. 
 Fixed a delay between messages and choices in the dialogue system. 
 The achievements transfer between the demo and the full game now works correctly. 
 Fixed a softlock when the player presses some combination on the keyboard or gamepad during cutscenes. 
 Fixed some bugs in cutscenes. 
 Fixed empty description for starter equipment. 
 Fixed issues with the garden when it rains. 
 Fixed visual artifacts in the forest battle scene. 
 Fixed issue interface "to be" shop. 
 Fixed visual bugs in dungeons. 
 Fixed a softlock when players interact with the bench at the fair. 
 Fixed quest “ask Sam about stones”. 
 Fixed the quest with mint 
 When creating a new save/overwriting an old one, the new one is now displayed at the top of the list instead of at the bottom 
 Fixed a bug with the lottery not working correctly (the limit on the number of participants per day could be reset) 
 Removed delays for skip text baubles 
 Updated locales

notes.title: Dev Diary - A Deep Dive into Creative Combat
notes.content:
Greetings Bloomtowners! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/920b9c85d893abb339250dd0512913a6466e7964.png

We've been hearing from visitors to Bloomtown that there is a bit too much mystery behind the combat systems of the game. We wanted to take some time to go over some of the more technical information about Bloomtown's combat and mechanics to make sure everything is as clear as a sunny vacation day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/d1f8def0c9b31c7778846df262240d8d2b69b5f0.png

Let's begin with each character's combat stats: Strength, Magic, Endurance, Agility, and Luck. While in battle, Emily and the other members of her group use these stats to enhance their performance, and they are pivotal in increasing your power as you play through the game. Your battle stats are modified depending on the demons you have equipped. Any hero (Emily, Chester, Ramona, and Hugo) gets the highest values for each stat from the values of their Defender demon and the second equipped demon (which you'll have to catch and equip first). The common rule to understand here is that the higher your stats get, the better the character will perform in battle.

Let's dive more in-depth into each battle stat:
 Strength - Determines the final damage from attacks, shots, and skills with physical attributes.
 Magic - Determine the final damage from all skills except physical ones.
 Endurance - Determines the final damage taken from attacks; it does not increase health.
 Agility - Affects your accuracy and evasion chance.
 Luck - Affects your chance of a critical hit. It also increases the chance of triggering status effects and your chance of avoiding status effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/0a84ec8f232d53bd141aaa8b94525ad72cccf74e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/ec41ed2221997a850129afbc829e7caa63f0042f.png

The next most important feature in combat is the Elemental System. Using demons, like with stats, Emily and her friends gain the ability to use spells in combat. Spells deal different types of damage, depending on their affinity: fire, ice, electric, wind, poison, or curse. The only other kinds of attack types that can be used are those by the heroes themselves; ranged and melee attacks both deal physical damage, and guns also have a unique type of damage.

Different demons tolerate damage types in varying ways, and it's essential to consider their elemental affinity in two cases: when attacking demons or when equipping them to your heroes for combat.
 If a demon is vulnerable to a specific type of damage (a red down arrow), it will take increased damage when hit with an attack of that type and go into a “Down” state.
 If a demon is resistant to an element (blue up arrow), it will take a reduced amount of damage and be protected from the associated status effects.
 If a demon is immune to an element (two blue up arrows), it will take no attack damage and be protected from associated status effects.
 If a demon absorbs an element (three blue up arrows), it will regenerate its health by the value of that element's attack damage. It will also be protected from associated status effects.
 If a demon reflects an element (also three blue up arrows), it takes no damage and reflects all damage to the attacker.
 If a demon is neutral to an element in any way (dash), it takes full damage from attacks and may be subject to associated status effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/21617402223419fa9f640c272d25ca29709a3ac0.png

When equipping a demon to a party member, consider their elemental affinities for reducing your incoming damage. Your heroes will only inherit the best possible resistance a demon has from each equipped demon. A captured demon's tolerance to a specific element can also be changed through fusion. The following changes can be made by chance through fusion by fusing them with a higher resistance chance demon: Vulnerable to neutral, neutral to resistant, resistant to immune, and immune to absorbing or reflective (randomly). These changes can only be made step by step, increasing by one resistance level per fusion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/42b1c0a2d45209a1792249f4c5b501420d428a64.png

Next, let's discuss spells and how they function in combat. Bloomtown has several spell types available to the player: Attack, Status, Debuff, Buff, and Heal.
 Attack spells deal damage directly and can have a varying chance of inflicting a corresponding status effect of their elemental affinity. These attacks can also 'Down' demons vulnerable to that specific element. Players cannot be downed. Instead, they receive increased damage from the spell.
 Status spells have a 100% chance to inflict the relevant status effect if the target's elemental resistance allows it. Do note that damaging status effects, like burn or electrify, cannot place a vulnerable demon into the 'Down' state. However, damage from Electrify on neighboring demons is affected by resistance modifiers, so it can be absorbed or reflected at the player.
 Buffs and debuffs quantitatively increase or decrease, respectively, the targets's combat stats.
 Healing spells restore health, and they cannot miss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/e5cfdba9e7144cc620dc42c1da94a597f0916b10.jpg

Here is an explanation of each of the different status effects that can be placed upon you or the demons you face:

 Frozen: Triggered by Ice attack spells - The affected target can't take any actions for three turns but gets 90% damage resistance. 
 Burning: Triggered by Fire attack spells - The affected target takes damage after taking an action for three turns. Guarding or using an item does not trigger this effect. 
 Woozed: Triggered by Wind attack spells - The affected target can't cast spells but can use physical attacks with 50% less accuracy for two turns. 
 Electrified: Triggered by Electric attack spells - When the affected target takes an action, its allies get damaged. Guarding or using an item does not trigger this effect. 
 Poisoned: Triggered by Poison attack spells - The affected target deals 70% less damage for three turns. 
 Insanity: Triggered by Shadow attack spells - The affected target attacks its allies on its next turn. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/fa534ccf66525c66bbd1c838631c55a62f403c2f.png

The last thing to note is the 'Combo' damage system that comes into play when you use an attack spell on a status-afflicted enemy. Using this to your advantage can significantly increase your damage at pivotal moments in battle.

 Ice spells deal double damage to Burning and Woozed targets.
 Fire spells deal double damage to Electrified and Woozed targets.
 Wind spells deal double damage to Frozen and Electrified targets.
 Electric spells deal double damage to Burned and Frozen targets.
 Poison spells deal double damage to Insane targets.
 Shadow spells deal double damage to Poisoned targets.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/fe3a3e4ceb7d4610f9295025617f8290e677c5ae.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c92f7ed78c30164137e841281361f2bdbaf01daa.png

Want to chat with the devs and the community? Need to be the first to know about our next patch? Encountering bugs? Have a suggestion to improve the game?

Join our 🎀 DISCORD 🎀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/dda8c3994d3c5d13094b5d2389d8f9261bd45a72.png

We hope that this blog helps expand your understanding of the systems that make Bloomtown's combat mechanics so interesting even clearer, and aids you in defeating the demon threat that is threatening this wonderful city! Best of luck in your battles, Bloomtowners, and enjoy that Summer vacation. 🧡

The Bloomtown Team

notes.title: Dev Diary - Behind Bloomtown’s Pixels: A Focus on Art
notes.content:
Good day, Bloomtowners! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/920b9c85d893abb339250dd0512913a6466e7964.png

Welcome to the Focus on Art dev diary! 

Many of you praised the pixel art, and the art direction of the game and had some questions about the iteration and creation processes used. So while we were working on the next update that will be released very soon, we wanted to create a blog that will shine a light on the team crafting Bloomtown behind the scenes. In this dev diary, we’ll dive into the game’s art, and design. 

We’re going to be diving into the pixel art magic of Bloomtown: A Different Story with Vitaly, our Art Director. He is here to share his insights on how we approach and craft the game's visuals. 
So check the Q&A we have lined up for you, where Vitaly discusses and explains our creative process!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/d45007297a8098b41af1366a977447d548bec1af.png
⬆ This is Vitaly—say hi everyone!! 👋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png

What artistic influences shaped the look and seel of Bloomtown’s Pixel Art?

I grew up playing games like Chrono Trigger, Far East of Eden Zero, Earthbound, Final Fantasy, and Shin Megami Tensei… The list can be continued for a long time, and perhaps this whole background helped me take a broader look at the world of Bloomtown.
However, while these classics are cherished for their signature nostalgic value, their visual styles wouldn’t resonate the same way today. Pixel art has evolved a lot, embracing a "pure style"—if you can call it that; clearer shapes, carefully selected palettes, and smooth animations.
And of course, texture plays a key role. Many artists now try to avoid the dithering effect, striving instead for a cleaner narrative, at the expense of shapes and palettes—a trend often noticed in gamedev.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/af855df9e6565ab3996b67c71c803cd1458891bf.png
This approach to rendering allows us to utilize a wider range of tools. For example, we often use many different gradients and soft brushes in post-processing to subtly expand the palette and, of course, to create and achieve the right mood.
One of the projects that greatly impressed me and influenced Bloomtown is, of course, Eastward, a game that stands out by its incredibly beautiful and stylish art.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/fa534ccf66525c66bbd1c838631c55a62f403c2f.png

What’s your favorite character design and the creative process behind it?

It’s hard to pick just one favorite character, but if I had to choose, it would be Hugo. Designing him was especially fun, considering the absurd transformation he undergoes in the game’s darker realm..! In the early stages, we toyed with a lot of crazy ideas for his design and combat behavior. And of course, Hugo is a good doggo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/ec41ed2221997a850129afbc829e7caa63f0042f.png

Can you walk us through the design process for a specific character? 
(e.g. How did you translate their personality and backstory into pixel art?)

In general, our character design process is quite straightforward. The game designer describes the character in one sentence, and from there, the rest begins to draw itself, taking into account the environment where we meet that character. 
Take Ruth, for example—she has a passion for radio equipment, and she works out of a cluttered garage/workshop. Her design naturally evolved into a tomboy girl in a bandana and jeans, reflecting her hands-on, no-nonsense personality. And when the game introduces you to Ruth in her environment, everything makes sense—it’s clear she is dedicated to her hobby, and she can be trusted to fix something.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/56c6cc58f9e195db9d9b56b7a1180f4c12ff2b85.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/42b1c0a2d45209a1792249f4c5b501420d428a64.png

Bloomtown’s world is a beautiful blend of cute and unsettling. How did you achieve the balance between these contrasting themes?

Initially, when we conceived this project, our game director set the tone by referencing two writers—Ray Bradbury and Stephen King. My task was to create a setting that balanced the cozy, calm world of Bloomtown with its darker, more distorted reflection, the Underside, where secrets and dangers lurk. 
Choosing the right color palette and post-processing techniques was crucial to avoiding a jarring dissonance between these two worlds. By expanding the palette with contrasting shades and making the render more tactile and tastefully deteriorated and destroyed, we struck the right balance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/d1f8def0c9b31c7778846df262240d8d2b69b5f0.png

Can you walk us through the design process behind Bloomtown’s locations?

It usually starts with the game designer outlining the location and its events. I then create a concept sketch that captures the palette and mood. I always try to make each place feel lively, filled with various little things and details, so that it speaks for itself and tells a story on its own. 
For larger locations, we break down the process into initial blocking and then filling it with points of interest having various unique assets. 
Many decisions are spontaneous, such as a giant kraken in the library, or the heads of giants in the abysses of the forest underbelly. I’ve always enjoyed adding some touches of absurdity and a sense of nightmare to these areas.

From Sketch:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/dac7ee9c65004f39b8c50b0ac52da31a1071a72b.png
To Post Production:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/3f84092d4f5340e9296512d88727b446c65fc13f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c92f7ed78c30164137e841281361f2bdbaf01daa.png

Did the pixel art style evolve significantly throughout Bloomtown’s development?

Of course! It has evolved significantly, reflecting how all team members grew and evolved themselves! Considering this, we actually kept an impressive amount of the old content. 
We tried to minimize the visual gap between the early assets and the later ones.We also refined our approach to using these assets, and although some older demons were retired from the project, the new ones we created are far superior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/c05b716b4b94e36845430e3bdd28f6f91a354909.png

Want to chat with the devs and the community? Need to be the first to know about our next patch? Encountering bugs? Have a suggestion to improve the game?

Join our 🎀 DISCORD 🎀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/dda8c3994d3c5d13094b5d2389d8f9261bd45a72.png

We hope you enjoyed this deep dive into the art of Bloomtown. 🧡

The Bloomtown Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/920b9c85d893abb339250dd0512913a6466e7964.png

Patch 1.0.8 – released on September 25th
 Fixed problems with crafting in Gloomtown.
 The 'Werewolf trophy' item was not correctly given for defeating a werewolf in the 'Proof of Power' subquest; it will also be added automatically to everyone who killed a werewolf and did not get the item.
 Players could have fewer 'Stone plates' than needed despite finishing the corresponding subquest in the 'Stone collection' quest. The missing number of plates will be automatically given to players.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/ed848065d081c814e274258dbc7cb1a8d7df6199.png

Patch 1.0.10 – released on September 27th
 Fixed a bug where players couldn't use the Telescope activity (in Staff & Parts shop) after finding the equipment needed for the upgrade. It can now be used any day after loading the game if you have completed the corresponding side quest.
 Achievement 'At the bottom of the sea' can now be obtained after catching all types of fish at least once without catching an additional fish. Players who caught all kinds of fish and didn't get an achievement only have to catch one more fish to get a trophy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/d19cbb81109e101247d9585f5a992f11458a901b.png

Patch 1.0.11 – released on September 30th
 Now, when you complete one of the quests, “Holy man's advice” or “Science man's advice,” the other one will be automatically completed.
 Fixed a bug that allowed players to participate in the activity “Telescope” an unlimited number of times per day.
 Fixed a bug that caused the game to softlock when receiving a reward for the activity “Telescope” at maximum levels of social stats.
 Fixed incorrect saving of new elemental resistances obtained when fusing demons.
 Fixed a bug that prevented players from getting vinyl records from the “Shooting Range” activity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/94e522586e2a2cc21903aa878521b94e7e63b11b.png

Patch 1.0.12 – released on September 30th
 Fixed a bug where players could not get into Gloomtown after being defeated by Lucifer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/f072a245a70427f9a1281e1de3afeb5e29edfc5b.png

Patch 1.0.13 – released on October 1st
 Improved monster balance.
 The game will no longer crash on Nintendo Switch when there is no Demo data to load.
 Corrected an incorrect dialog sequence in the “Criminal Peanuts” quest.
 Players can no longer insert all the tiles in the puzzles with statues and enter the asylum building without attacking the gardener.
 The hint for this puzzle is no longer needed as we disabled the puzzle itself. Now, you can just insert the tiles.
 Lewis' meal recipes are no longer available before completing the "Find the cook" quest.
 Some another minor fixes in cutscenes and locales

notes.title: Release date announcement 🎒
notes.content:
Greetings, Bloomtowners!

It's official, we finally have a release date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8b805179ad60a63d4a27fffd3dd5750ac7daf061.png

[previewyoutube=EPCGMsk9nHg;full][/previewyoutube]

Bloomtown will launch on PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4/PS5 and Xbox One & Xbox Series on September 24, 2024!

Play as Emily and her younger brother Chester, who are spending their summer holiday in their grandpa’s seemingly cozy and quiet town. But maybe too quiet—children are vanishing, and nightmares are coming to life... As a 12-year-old adventurer, it’s up to you to uncover the mystery and save Bloomtown from a dark fate!

As a heads-up, if you're in Japan or Korea, Bloomtown will launch on September 26th on Nintendo Switch!

Whether you found out about Bloomtown: A Different Story years ago or just now, we're grateful for all of the support you've shown us. If you can, don't forget to wishlist the game on Steam and share the news with your friends, family, community, or even your favorite content creator!

HOW DO I ACCESS THE DEMO?

Head over to our Steam page here and just click on "Download Bloomtown: A Different Story Demo":

WHERE DO I SHARE MY FEEDBACK?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/608b2c4a77850b45b40805378871f12c09e905ac.png

If you're playing the demo, we highly recommend that you join our Discord to give your feedback and discuss with the team and devs!
This will make it much easier for us to gather everything you might share and answer to everyone in one place :)
There are even dedicated channels on our server for the Closed Alpha participants.

🎒 TAKE ME TO THE DISCORD PLEASE 🎒

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png

WHAT CONTENT CAN I EXPECT?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/336c7a6e04e491d31b5ff18558d94a19ba6fe438.png

You will be able to explore half of the content, stories, missions, combats and side activities of chapter one in this demo!
In this initial chapter, you will experience your arrival in Bloomtown, forging your first friendships, earning your first coins, and gradually unveiling the 'peculiar occurrences' happening in town... leading to fighting your first demons in the Underside.

You will get to discover (or re-discover if you come from the Closed Alpha!) the numerous and various aspects of gameplay Bloomtown has to offer - in a nutshell, a narrative JRPG mixing turn-based combat, monster taming and social RPG elements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/1868e67fa2cb3936f69e9b5ee6b1f53fd63ebf8d.png

What platform can I play the Demo on?

The Bloomtown Closed Alpha will be available on PC Windows for Steam exclusively.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Can I stream/record the game?

Yes! You can stream or record our demo. Feel free to tag us on X (formerly known as Twitter) @BloomtownGame!

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

What is the difference with the Closed Alpha?

We have taken into account player feedback to improve combat, improve tutorial on some key gameplay concept and change some part of the story.
The Closed Alpha also helped us improve the other three chapters for us to focus on the right features.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

When will the game release?

We are planning a release on Q3 2024. We moved back the release date by a quarter from our first announcement last year. We took that decision after taking into account player feedback provided during the december Closed Alpha, to be able to provide the best possible game experience to you all!

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Will I be able to keep my progress at launch?

The Demo is an early and short version of our game and subjected to change and improvement. Our goal is to gather feedback to eventually create the best possible version of the game. Before the full release, chapter 1 will have changed, meaning that, unfortunately, your progress will not be carried over.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Is playing on gamepad still mandatory?

Gamepad is recommended to play the demo. Keyboard is usable but not customizable. This is why we recommend playing with a gamepad. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png


Thank you for all the love you showed us on Twitter and Discord through the months!

We are super thrilled to see you in the world of Bloomtown!

The Bloomtown Team

We have also sent in your email a dedicated Closed Alpha questionnaire for you to evaluate your experience playing Bloomtown's first chapter! Please take the time to fill it and send it back as that will help us greatly! Thank you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png

WHAT CONTENT CAN I EXPECT?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/336c7a6e04e491d31b5ff18558d94a19ba6fe438.png

We have been working hard for a few years now to provide you with the best narrative JRPG, blending turn-based combat, monster taming & social RPG aspects. We have improved gameplay elements, mechanics and added a ton of content! 

This Closed Alpha is being set up to test the game’s core mechanics and have your feedback to improve our full release, scheduled for 2024. 

On a more concrete note, you will be able to explore the entirety of the first chapter of the game!
In this initial chapter, you will experience your arrival in Bloomtown, forging your first friendships, earning your first coins, and gradually unveiling the 'peculiar occurrences' happening in town... leading to fighting your first demons in the Underworld.
Lots of first as we want you to have the most exciting experience possible in this Closed Alpha!

You will get to discover the numerous and various aspects of gameplay Bloomtown has to offer - in a nutshell, a narrative JRPG mixing turn-based combat, monster taming and social RPG elements!
Those of you who are the most keen-eyed and thorough will even be able to uncover a cool hidden activity...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png

KNOWN ISSUES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/7bed581a87eec7ee8b2bf498115f10acaa8e9d47.png

Long loading times when moving to Suburbs and City Center.
The game stutters for a bit after changing the resolution.
Volume sliders are sometimes bugged.
Companions stop following you after the game resolution is changed. They start following after you change the location or reload the save.
Some quests are not marked on the map yet.
Some spells don’t play the sound they are supposed to.
Some minor visual glitches when using 16:10 resolutions are present.
The wrong demon is displayed sometimes when you use a spell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/1868e67fa2cb3936f69e9b5ee6b1f53fd63ebf8d.png

What platform can I play the Closed Alpha on?

The Bloomtown Closed Alpha will be available on PC Windows for Steam exclusively.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Can I stream/record the game?

While there is no formal NDA in place, we kindly request players not to share gameplay content publicly, as it might not represent the final, polished experience. Your understanding and support mean a lot!

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Why do I need a gamepad to play?

This is specific to the Closed Alpha which is only playable on gamepad however, mouse & keyboard control will be available at full release.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

When will the game release?

We are planning a release in Q2 2024!

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Will I be able to keep my progress at launch?

The Closed Alpha is a test period, our goal being to gather your feedback to eventually create the best possible version of the game. Before the full release, chapter 1 will have changed substantially, meaning that, unfortunately, your progress will not be carried over.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

What is the duration of the Closed Alpha?

This varies depending on your playstyle: if you follow the main storyline, it should be around 3 hours long.
However, if you are exploring every detail we carefully put in there, it should be closer to 4-5 hours.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

How long will this Closed Alpha last?

It is starting today, on December 7th and will be closing on December 18th. After that date, we will be closing the Closed Alpha branch on Steam permanently. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png


Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!!!

We are VERY excited to see you in the world of Bloomtown!

The Bloomtown Team

notes.title: REGISTER TO OUR CLOSED ALPHA
notes.content:
Welcome to all and each of you Bloomtown enthusiasts!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8b805179ad60a63d4a27fffd3dd5750ac7daf061.png

We’re excited to say that Bloomtown: A Different Story has now reached a stage where it would benefit from your valuable feedback. 
Soon, we will be holding our first Closed Alpha test!

Thus, we are opening TODAY the registration for our Closed Alpha coming in December! If you think you will be able to participate in this test and provide feedback, please check how to register below.

Keep in mind that, as the game is still in progress, we cannot grant access to all players at this stage.
This initial Closed Alpha will be with a small number of players, and filling in the form does not guarantee a spot. But do not worry, as we have plans to release a demo for everyone next year!

We have been working hard for a few years now to provide you with the best narrative JRPG, blending turn-based combat, monster taming & social RPG aspects.
We have improved gameplay elements, mechanics and added a ton of content! 

This Closed Alpha is being set up to test the game’s core mechanics and have your feedback to improve our full release, scheduled for 2024. You will be able to explore the entirety of the first chapter!

We would greatly appreciate your support and can’t wait to have you play our game!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/4e7d439284877e17aa6ec318766c819585579cb6.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png
HOW DO I REGISTER?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/1e10ace177bfe4ea68cea5ce5d85f7548d788038.png

You can register from today until the 28th of November!
For this, you simply need to fill out this form: 

CLOSED ALPHA SIGN-UP SURVEY

In order to make the process as smooth and valuable as possible, please answer as accurately as you can.

Thank you for signing up - we can’t wait for you to get a taste of Bloomtown: A Different Story!
You’ll get informed if you are selected once we’ve started the Closed Alpha Process.

Follow us on Twitter to get all the latest news on the Closed Alpha and Bloomtown!

As we keep working on completing the content for our Closed Alpha, we want to clarify that it's still a work in progress. We are committed to ensuring that it provides a solid representation of what Bloomtown will look like at the full release.  

Rest assured, you'll have a wealth of content to explore, experiment with and help us fine-tune during this phase!
 
Your feedback will be invaluable in improving the game and refining Bloomtown further as we march toward the 2024 release.

You will hear from us soon about more details regarding the Closed Alpha dates and content! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png
STAY IN TOUCH!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/920b9c85d893abb339250dd0512913a6466e7964.png

If you want to stay up to date with the latest news & announcements or simply see more pixel art, you can follow us on our Twitter page!

We also have a Discord that's under construction 🚧 !
You're welcome to join to share, talk & have a good time.

You will be received with much love and many pixels!

Take care and until next time, Bloomtowners ♡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237207/8f99106aded19294bb65a468576ca2928efd2b0b.png

BLOOMTOWN REVEAL TRAILER

We're thrilled to present the first-ever gameplay trailer of Bloomtown!!

[previewyoutube=tvwuM4Lh_M8;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as Emily and her younger brother Chester sent on their summer holiday to their grandpa’s cozy and quiet town. 
Maybe too quiet… 
Children starting to disappear, nightmares getting more real… 
Something’s not right, especially for a 12-year-old girl with an adventurous mind!  

It is up to you to solve this mystery and free Bloomtown and its inhabitants from a glooming fate! 
Join Emily & her friends on this unforgettable adventure 🥾
